card.name: Words just before 'modern' or 'today'
card.fires_on: Short linking words (we, like, in, way, of, by, on, above) right before a comparison to the present day, such as 'modern', 'today', 'our day' or 'present level'. Seen in general prose about history, fossils and science.

modes.label: Comparing past to modern
